e.title: Insurance_Agentic (医疗险)
e.summary: 中国医疗险理赔 Agentic RAG 多智能体系统（15★，2026-08 活跃）：强制条款引用+确定性核算+一致性审查
e.body: Insurance_Agentic（hbqdcq/Insurance-Agent，15★，Python，2026-08-31 活跃）是面向中国医疗险场景（尊享 e 生产品族样板语料）的 Agentic RAG 多智能体系统：LangGraph 编排的可审计理赔初审流水线——每次赔付结论必须由召回条款支撑、确定性规则复算、独立审查节点校验，失信任自动降级转人工；双模式：零外部依赖离线精确运行（无 ES/GPU/Ollama 跑通样例案件）与生产切换（接 vLLM/ES/BGE 无需改业务代码）。对 RIAA：中国医疗险理赔核算/核保的 agentic 实现——「LLM 生成→确定性核算核心→一致性审查」零幻觉架构与 [[agentic-bop-underwriting]]（直通核保）、[[claims-processing-hack]]（理赔黑客松）、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]（LangGraph 理赔）对照；中文医疗险条款 RAG 场景贴合 [[claims-intake-agent]] 的受理应用。

e.summary_en: Chinese medical-insurance claims Agentic-RAG multi-agent system (15★, active 2026-08): mandatory clause citation + deterministic accounting + consistency review
e.summary_hk: 中國醫療險理賠 Agentic RAG 多智能體系統（15★，2026-08 活躍）：強制條款引用+確定性核算+一致性審查
e.body_en: Insurance_Agentic (hbqdcq/Insurance-Agent, 15★, Python, active 2026-08-31) is an Agentic-RAG multi-agent system for Chinese medical-insurance scenarios (the 'Zunxiang e-sheng' product family as sample corpus): a LangGraph-orchestrated, auditable claims first-review pipeline — every payout conclusion must be supported by retrieved clauses, recomputed by deterministic rules and validated by an independent review node, auto-degrading to human review on any trust failure; dual-mode: zero-dependency offline exact operation (runs sample cases without ES/GPU/Ollama) and production switch (plug in vLLM/ES/BGE with no business-code changes). For RIAA: an agentic implementation of Chinese medical-claims accounting/underwriting — the 'LLM generation → deterministic accounting core → consistency review' zero-hallucination architecture contrasts with [[agentic-bop-underwriting]] (straight-through underwriting), [[claims-processing-hack]] (claims hackathon) and [[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]] (LangGraph claims); the Chinese medical-clause RAG scenario maps to the intake applications of [[claims-intake-agent]].
e.body_hk: Insurance_Agentic（hbqdcq/Insurance-Agent，15★，Python，2026-08-31 活躍）是面向中國醫療險場景（尊享 e 生產品族樣板語料）的 Agentic RAG 多智能體系統：LangGraph 編排的可審計理賠初審流水線——每次賠付結論必須由召回條款支撐、確定性規則複算、獨立審查節點校驗，失信任自動降級轉人工；雙模式：零外部依賴離線精確運行（無 ES/GPU/Ollama 跑通樣例案件）與生產切換（接 vLLM/ES/BGE 無需改業務程式碼）。對 RIAA：中國醫療險理賠核算/核保的 agentic 實現——「LLM 生成→確定性核算核心→一致性審查」零幻覺架構與 [[agentic-bop-underwriting]]（直通核保）、[[claims-processing-hack]]（理賠黑客松）、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]（LangGraph 理賠）對照；中文醫療險條款 RAG 場景貼合 [[claims-intake-agent]] 的受理應用。
